{{Top|leg}}
The '''contour wetsuit''' was a flat-back dive suit covered in a scaly material. It conformed to the wearer's body, while the scaly material insulated the [[diver]] from the cold depths of the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]. The [[Seabed Lodge]], part of the [[Fathoms]] complex, rented contour wetsuits to its guests for underwater recreational activities.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
